cleavage agent: 1 μg of trypsin (Sus scrofa) was added
collision energy: fragmented by low energy CID, 35% collision energy
instrument: An LTQ OrbitrapVelos (Thermo Fisher) was used
ionization type: The eluate was applied to the nanospray source of the Orbitrap spectrometer
labeling: The MS/MS was performed in the LTQ and the top 20 most intense peptides were isolated and fragmented by low energy CID, 35% collision energy.
mass analyzer: The MS/MS was performed in the LTQ
ptm: oxidation of methionine (variable); carbamidomethylation of cysteine (fixed)
oxidation of methionine as the variable modification and carbamidomethylation of cysteine as the fixed modification
reduction reagent: Samples of isolated vesicles (rexPy) were reduced with 10 mM DTT (Dithiothreitol)
reduction concentration: Samples of isolated vesicles (rexPy) were reduced with 10 mM DTT (Dithiothreitol)
